meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将 Python 应用部署到 Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把 Flask/Django/FastAPI 应用部署到 Azure
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Flask/Django/FastAPI apps to Azure

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能将 Python 代码（Flask、Django、FastAPI 等）部署到 Azure App Service Linux。它会自动创建资源组、托管计划和 Web 应用，并设置启动命令和环境变量，最后部署代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“Flask App Service”、“Django App Service”、“FastAPI App Service”或“deploy Python to App Service”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把我的 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service。
say.note: Claude 会创建资源并部署代码。

say.text: 部署 Django 项目到 App Service。
say.note: Claude 会自动检测框架并配置。

say.text: 将 FastAPI 应用部署到 Azure。
say.note: Claude 会设置 uvicorn 启动命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can deploy Python code (Flask, Django, FastAPI, etc.) to Azure App Service Linux. It automatically creates resource group, hosting plan, and web app, sets startup command and environment variables, then deploys the code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", or "deploy Python to App Service".

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service.
say_en.note: Claude will create resources and deploy code.

say_en.text: Deploy Django project to App Service.
